in_sanskrit.name: जतिनेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: जति (Jati) - birth, origin नेन्द्र (Nendra) - lord, ruler Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the lord of birth or origin of knowledge and wisdom'

in_hindi.name: जतिनेन्द्र
in_hindi.meaning: जाति (Jati) - birth, origin नेन्द्र (Nendra) - नेता (Netaa) + राजा (Raja) - leader + king
in_hindi.long_meaning: जाति (Jati) से उर्जा हुई जन्म या श्रोत्रियता से जानना चाहता है नेता (Netaa) के रूप से राजा (Raja) के रूप में विज्ञान वा ग्यान का ईमादित्र (Ishwar) है। Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the leader and king who desires to acquire knowledge and wisdom from the source of birth'

in_tamil.name: ஜதிநேந்திர
in_tamil.meaning: ஜதி (Jathi) - birth நேந்திர (Nendhir) - நேர் (Neer) + திரு (Thiru) + இரும்பு (Irumbu) - ocean, river Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the one who has the power to control the ocean or river of knowledge'

in_telugu.name: జటినేద్ర
in_telugu.meaning: జటి (Jati) - birth ఎణ్ణద్ర (Nendra) - ఎణ్ణ (Enna) + ద్రీశ్య (Drisya) + రాజ (Raja) - lord Therefore, Jatinendra can be interpreted as 'the one who is the lord of the source of knowledge'

in_marathi.name: Jatinendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jatinendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jatinendra is a compound name derived from Sanskrit roots Jati (birth, origin) and Indra (ruler, king of the gods). The name means 'Lord of the Earth' or 'Son of Indra'.

in_bengali.name: Jatinendra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jatinendra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jatinendra is a compound name derived from Sanskrit roots Jati (birth, origin) and Indra (ruler, king of the gods). The name means 'Lord of the Earth' or 'Son of Indra'.
